description.value: Your exocortex has become such a seamless extension of your own body and mind that you can flawlessly activate it without a second thought. You're permanently @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Quickened]. You can use your extra action to only to Command your drone (or to provide 1 of the actions if you choose to spend 2 actions to Command your drone), make a ranged Strike with your turret, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Detonate Mine].
